prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a hit while turning left. The patient had 7 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1280; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which the patient's vehicle was struck while turning left at an intersection. The patient reported immediate pain in the right shoulder, limited range of motion, and difficulty lifting the arm above shoulder level. Initial examination showed tenderness over the anterior shoulder, reduced active abduction and external rotation, and mild swelling. Imaging was reviewed and showed no fracture or dislocation. A clinical impression of right rotator cuff strain with associated soft tissue inflammation was made.

Over a total of seven visits, treatment consisted of a structured physical therapy program focusing on gentle range of motion exercises, progressive strengthening of the rotator cuff and scapular stabilizers, and manual therapy to address stiffness. Anti-inflammatory medication was prescribed for pain control, and activity modifications were recommended, including avoiding overhead lifting during the early recovery phase.

By the final visit, the patient demonstrated substantial improvement in pain levels and shoulder range of motion, with near-full active abduction and improved strength on manual testing. The patient reports being able to resume most daily activities. Residual mild discomfort with heavy overhead tasks remains. A home exercise program was provided, and follow-up was advised as needed should symptoms recur.
